name: idle
description: No input and no output for 14 minutes is a STALL, not health: a process that is alive but idle has made no progress, and process liveness is not evidence of progress. Point it at anything whose output moves while work is happening -- a run log, a pty byte counter, a queue -- with 'watch --preset idle --locator run:repo-7 -- <command>'. The clear event reports how long the stall lasted.
